summary: st-test fetches the base and chooses the commit to sign after it has a pool tree, not before the wait for one, so a merge it signs is as old as the run and not the run plus its wait

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

rules.detail: The gate's rules are unchanged; st-test signs the tree the gate will judge at the base's tip after the wait instead of before it.

compatibility.detail: Notes and checks are unchanged. A run that did not wait for a tree signs the same commit as before.
